notes:
v4.6.144 — GLM (Zhipu/Z.ai) models + live cost indicator

🤖 New AI provider: GLM (Zhipu / Z.ai) is now selectable for every bot, with all models — glm-4.6v / glm-4.5v (vision, great for chart-reading), glm-4.6 / glm-4.5 / glm-4.5-air (text), plus glm-4.7 / glm-5. GLM is OpenAI-compatible, has vision, and is the cheapest vision option (~$0.30/$0.90 per 1M tokens). Add your key as GLM_API_KEY in the .env. Server-side weekly stock reviews can use it too (APEX_SERVER_GLM_KEY).

💰 Live cost indicator: the AI settings now show what the SELECTED model actually costs to run — switch the provider/model dropdown and the projected $/call, $/day and $/month update instantly, so you can compare models before saving. Free-tier models read 'FREE'.

🧮 Cost fixed everywhere: all cost estimates (API COST card, call-delay preview) now price at the model your bot is actually using instead of always assuming Claude Haiku. The 'CLAUDE CALLS' card is now 'AI CALLS'.

🎯 Position gauge (from 4.6.143): always shows EVERY open position — positions whose broker reports no entry price (some IBKR sub-portfolios) no longer vanish — and bots without their own take-profit/stop-loss now get realistic per-stock targets sized by each stock's own ATR/volatility instead of a flat band.

Update via the in-app banner.
